name: Utelogy
situation: AV and IoT estates were controlled device by device, with no central view of any of it.
obstacle: Microsoft’s Azure security team needed dashboards across 100+ monitors as a single video wall, on-premises and dependable.
decision: Architected U-Control 2.0 in C# and .NET, with hardware drivers surfaced to the frontend through WebSocket and SignalR, deployed via Azure DevOps.
result: Adoption grew over 600%, reaching 300+ schools in Southern California, and the video wall shipped as a core Utelogy offering.
